verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents an MD_INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY view that records every query run across the organization, which gives a first-party basis for auditing what was run. Its documented home is the billing and usage-monitoring docs, though, and the evidence does not state that it is a governance-grade audit log. Nothing in the pack addresses column-level lineage. missing for 10: column-level lineage of data origins, explicit per-user attribution and audit-log retention/export detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
